preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 200.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 200.
The number of chips k must be between 1 and 200.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sx_i <= n and 1 <= sy_i <= m for sx_i, sy_i in zip(sx, sy))
preconditions.description: Each chip's starting position must be within the board's dimensions.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fx_i <= n and 1 <= fy_i <= m for fx_i, fy_i in zip(fx, fy))
preconditions.description: Each chip's target position must be within the board's dimensions.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == 2 and int(stdout.splitlines()[0]) <= 2 * n * m)
postconditions.description: The output must either be '-1' indicating impossibility or a valid sequence of operations within the allowed limit.

postconditions.expression: any((x, y) in visited for x, y in zip(fx, fy))
postconditions.description: At least one chip must visit its target position.
